LanguageData.SSC_Setting_EnableRitualDevelopmentPoint: Contract rituals award ideoligion development points

Disabled by default. When enabled, SSC contract rituals can award development points to the ritual's fluid ideoligion: terrible and boring +0, good +1, best +2. Vanilla development requirements and the reformation point cap still apply. The current setting is checked when the ritual resolves. Disabling it only stops this reward; existing points and other ritual effects are preserved. This setting is shared by all saves.
